status: recipe only; not run (lane time, real models, final suite)
rule: A route is 'recommended' for a role only if it meets every floor of that role on two consecutive runs; 'usable' when it answers and parses below a floor; 'refused' when it fails isolation or does not parse. Defaults stay 'Same as memory model' whatever the numbers. Floors are v2.4 plan 08's, never retuned.
preconditions: server-plugin/story-orchestrator-harness installed (npm run plugin:install) and ST restarted
plugins/story-orchestrator-harness/config.json sets offer: true for the harness under test, and PHASE0 isolation rows green for it
the CLI is logged in on the ST machine (the plugin refuses a stale login: run the CLI once in a terminal, never inside a copy)
opencode: POST /api/plugins/story-orchestrator-harness/warm once as admin before the first arm
dev build staged (npm run build:dev && npm run stage -- --flavor dev), st-session reload
so-run-header capture before the batch, diff after
